lines: Supported Skills can only have one active Totem
Totems created by Supported Skills can splinter up to 2 times

Totems created by Supported Skills have 20% less
area of effect for each time they have splintered
Totems created by Supported Skills deal 20% less damage for each time they have splintered

Totems created by Supported Skills have 20% less maximum
Life for each time they have splintered
Totems created by Supported Skills have 10% less Skill Speed for each time they have splintered

Totems created by Supported Skills splinter after
performing 1 action
